svg.text: From first setup to daily operations
Learn this flow first and you can run daily operations

g.text: 1. Before opening
Check store, menu, staff
2. Take orders
QR or staff entry
3. Kitchen
Cook → mark served
4. Checkout
Discount, pay, receipt
5. Close & review
Sales, stock, attendance
• ⚙️ Settings: country, currency, tax, service charge and seating
• 🍽️ Menu: items, prices, service hours and kitchen display
• 👥 Staff: add users and give only the permissions they need
• 📦 If using stock: enter starting stock, minimums and recipes
• 🖨️ If needed: check printer, receipts and payment methods
You can change these later from Settings, Menu and Staff.

svg.text: 🧾 During service: from order to checkout

g.text: 1. Guests order by table QR, or staff use Order Entry
2. Kitchen checks KDS/tickets, cooks, then marks items Served
3. Floor staff watch order status, calls and bill requests
4. At checkout, confirm guests, discounts, payment and total
5. Give a printed or e-receipt when needed
Voids, refunds and discounts should follow your store's approval rules.
🙋 Floor: Orders / Order Entry / Checkout / Guest calls
🍳 Kitchen: KDS / tickets / mark orders Served
⏰ Staff: clock in, break, clock out
🧑‍💼 Manager: sales, stock, staff, customers and settings
Visible functions depend on user permissions and the Free/Pro plan.
• 💵 Review sales and receipts; close register or reprint if needed
• 📦 Review stock, stocktake and purchasing; replenish shortages
• 🕐 Review attendance/payroll estimates, permissions and to-dos
• 🎁 Review members, coupons, reservations and business reports
Review important sales, checkout and attendance data regularly and export when needed.

svg.text: 🆘 When something goes wrong & safe operation

g.text: • Strange screen: refresh or reopen the screen first; if needed, sign in again
• Order/checkout mismatch: check order status and receipt history before repeating an action
• Permission issue: a manager reviews the user's role and permissions
• Bug or request: send it from Support; use Staff Requests / To-dos for internal work
• Critical actions: the store must finally verify voids, refunds, tax, attendance and payroll estimates
This page is the big-picture guide. Use each screen's “?” help for detailed steps.
